Long, wavy ocean-blue hair with straight bangs and a glossy texture. Large, round turquoise eyes with a gentle, wide-eyed expression. Appears to be in the late teens with a soft, youthful facial structure. Slender build wearing a white and light-blue nautical-themed dress with a translucent blue raincoat. Features a pair of translucent, iridescent blue fish-like fins extending from the head and a matching long, flowing fish tail.
BODY COLOR: pale cream
